level_method.rule: Measure, never guess (house rule; beds mastered hot, catalog mean_db -9.5 to -14.9).
steps: 1. ffmpeg -i spine\ALL.e.desilenced.mp4 -af ebur128 -f null - -> VO integrated LUFS (expect ~-19 to -24).
2. Same ebur128 on each of the 4 bed files -> bed integrated LUFS.
3. Per bed: gain_db = (VO_LUFS - bed_LUFS) - target_under_vo; Remotion volume = 10**(gain_db/20), declared as an explicit per-bed MUSIC_DB constant (never a raw decimal).
4. QA: check the music floor in a no-VO breath of EACH bed; render a 10s chunk per bed and LISTEN (video-qa.md) — never integrated-LUFS-only.
